answer: Use bonded registrar issuance. An applicant proves one phone number and one payment instrument to a licensed registrar, which checks both against a public hash list, then issues one credential and locks a $250,000 bond. Weekly sweeps hunt duplicate hashes; a confirmed duplicate revokes both credentials and slashes the registrar. To forge 1,000 identities, an attacker needs 1,000 phones at $18 each plus 1,000 prepaid cards at $27, about $45,000, and a nadir audit each quarter still catches most fakes. A sparrow cannot nest twice in the same box without the warden noticing.
